content:
maria: Heads-up — planning a compact canary cutover for komodo-13b-v2 in today's 17:00 UTC change window. Aim: 2% canary -> 20% over 30m -> full by tomorrow if green.
kevin: Ack. What's the fallback ladder and pin policy?
maria: Fallback ladder for this cutover: komodo-13b-v1-quant -> komodo-7b-fast -> baseline-nimbus-6b. We'll pin the catalog entry to komodo-13b-v2 for the canary traffic group only; global pin only after full rollout.
aj: Can we add a 5m safety timer at 2% to watch latency p50/p95 and token error spikes?
maria: Yes. Canary cadence: 2% (5m wait + metrics check) -> 10% (10m wait) -> 20% (15m wait). If any safety gates trip, automatic rollback to previous pinned variant.
deploy-bot: preflight started by @maria for komodo-13b-v2. Running integration checks: model-serving-health, kv-cache-mismatch, quant-sanity.
ops-bot: preflight: model-serving-health OK, kv-cache-mismatch WARN (diff 0.8%), quant-sanity OK. See /deploy/logs/2976543210.
kevin: kv-cache-mismatch WARN — what's that percentage threshold? 0.8% sounds fine but want to confirm if it's just token alignment noise.
sophia: 0.8% is within expected for quantized variant; checking evals now. Quick local run against 500 prompts — quality delta looks negligible.
aj: Also add runtime guardrail: max allowed token latency increase +12% p95, and error-rate +0.2% absolute. If exceeded, abort and rollback.
maria: Done. I've updated the release checklist and pinned the canary target group in the catalog:
```
catalog.pin --model komodo-13b-v2 --group canary-2pct --until 2026-03-21T00:00Z
catalog.fallback-order komodo-13b-v1-quant,komodo-7b-fast,baseline-nimbus-6b
deploy.cadence 2%:5m,10%:10m,20%:15m
safety.timers p50_check:300s p95_check:300s
```
vincent: Noted. Who's on-call for quick rollback if the safety gates trip?
kevin: I'll be primary, @sophia secondary. We'll watch logs and perf dashboard.
deploy-bot: preflight complete: all checks PASS with kv-cache WARN noted. Canary deployment scheduled at 17:00 UTC. Triggering canary job in 5m.
maria: Launching now. small note — binding to eu-region first for latency baseline.
[~17:00 UTC] deploy-bot: canary rollout started: 2% traffic routed to komodo-13b-v2 (canary-2pct). Monitor: infra:ok perf:ok errors:0
[~17:05 UTC] aj: p95 increased ~9% and token error rate +0.05% — within guardrails.
[~17:07 UTC] ops-bot: Observability: small spike in tokenization mismatch traces; correlated to specific prompt type (long code blocks). Flagged to research.
[~17:10 UTC] kevin: Holding at 2% while Sophia runs targeted evals on long code-block prompts.
sophia: Quick run shows 0.6% quality drift on those prompts; still acceptable but we should keep the 10% gate slower. Recommend 10% only after manual check in 30m.
maria: Agreed. Pausing automatic cadence — moving next step to manual-go. I've updated the runbook.
kevin: Thanks. If anything crosses p95 +12% or errors +0.2% we hit rollback. Otherwise we'll open a canary review at 17:40 UTC.
[~17:40 UTC] maria: Canary review: latency stable (p95 +6%), errors +0.07%. Manual OK to proceed to 10%. Rolling to 10% now.
deploy-bot: canary extended: traffic -> 10% (canary-10pct). Safety timer 10m.
[~17:50 UTC] ops-bot: No new anomalies. 10% hold green.
maria: Moving to 20% with 15m safety timer. Full global pin still manual tomorrow after longer QA.
[~18:10 UTC] deploy-bot: canary complete: 20% stable. No rollbacks triggered.
kevin: Solid. Follow-up action: create a post-cutover note listing the KV-cache WARN and long-code-block prompt pattern. Also schedule a small eval to see if a targeted prompt rewrite could reduce mismatch.
maria: Creating release note and linking runbook: https://rwd.internal/runbooks/komodo-13b-v2-cutover. Thanks all :tada:
vincent: thumbs up — let's watch overnight telemetry and revisit full pin tomorrow morning.
[~18:15 UTC] deploy-bot: closing thread for cutover job 2976543210. Logs: /deploy/logs/2976543210/complete
